passages.text: Obviously, the bag contains diverse expres- sions of a question, which may provide more matching evidence than only one question due to the rich information contained in the bag. Motivated by the fact, different from existing query-question (Q-Q) matching method, we propose a new query-bag matching ap- proach for retrieval-based chatbots. Concretely, when a user raises a query, the query-bag matching model provides the most suitable bag and returns the corresponding answer of the bag.
